items.name: One Million Coins

Talk to customers, hear their stories, and see how your decisions impact both their lives and your shop.

items.name: Brick by Brick: Tidy Up the Small Town!

items.name: No More Room in Hell 2
items.sub: Torn Banner Studios · Early Access, Zombies, Multiplayer
items.desc: No More Room in Hell 2 is an intense 8 player zombie shooter. Overcome the endless undead. Avoid infection. Survive hell together.

items.name: CloverPit
items.desc: A rogue-lite slot machine nightmare. Gamble for your life in a never-ending debt simulator!

items.name: Godius Eternal War
items.desc: A classic 2D pixel MMORPG inspired by the golden age of online RPGs. Join nation wars, explore an open multiplayer world, trade with players, battle in PvP, and experience a community-driven adventure that has continued since 1999.

items.name: Date Everything!
items.desc: Date Everything! is a sandbox dating simulator set in the comfort of your own home, featuring 100 fully voice acted datable characters! Let the romance flow between your bed, smoke alarm and… Overwhelming Sense of Existential Dread? Are you ready to Date Everything?

items.name: Tiny Eden
items.desc: A cozy first-person farming sim, set in the heart of a futuristic city. Grow plants, cook what you harvest, and discover new varieties as you turn your apartment into a thriving urban garden, from a small balcony to a rooftop paradise.

items.name: TCG Card Shop Simulator
items.desc: Open your own local game store. Stock shelves with the latest booster packs, or crack them and collect the cards for yourself. Set your own prices, hire staff, host events, and expand your card shop.

items.name: Megastore: Tidy Up Together
items.desc: Megastore: Tidy Up Together is a cozy sorting game for solo or online co-op play. Organize four stores of increasing scale: a Toy Store, an Electronics Store, a bustling Supermarket, and a massive two-story Megastore. Pick up, sort, and shelve thousands of items, and get ready to open!

items.name: Potato Please
items.desc: A first-person potato peeling game. You have a knife. You have a bucket. You have a mountain of potatoes. Peel them with real physics. Cut thin, waste nothing. Buy better tools. Finish the pile.

items.name: Scared Crow
items.desc: Scared Crow is a 5×5-grid roguelite deckbuilder. Add up to three ability stickers to each card, plan each week before the Boss arrives, and turn humble cards into build-defining powerhouses. Clear a run, challenge other players’ winning decks, and climb the leaderboard.

items.name: Lazy Drawer: Line Survivors
items.desc: No guns. No swords. No aiming. Your weapon is the path you walk. Enemies touching your trail get shredded — and the instant it closes into a loop, everything inside blows up at once. Survive 15 minutes, slay the boss, grow your charm deck — a survivors-like where walking IS attacking.

items.name: Neuroflip
items.desc: A card-based memory roguelike. Flip cards, remember where each face appeared and match pairs to defeat the Scribe, the Lady and the King. Missing on a new card is free; forgetting a pair you've already seen can cost you dearly.

items.name: Camera 5
items.desc: Five cameras. Five nights. One caretaker who's starting to notice too much. A slow-burn surveillance horror where the building lies to you — and the system does too.

items.name: Stellar Smash
items.desc: Save the universe from complete darkness by destroying bricks one by one in this brick breaking game. Challenge bosses, master ball control and upgrade your ship. Let the main character, Astra, guide you through the game.
